summary: Keep the next step close to the decision.

useWhen.text: Keep the next step close to the decision.

from.quote: Keep the next step close to the decision.

useWhen.text: To keep the final decision of a composition, such as confirming a reviewed payment, at the bottom of the host.

from.quote: The public footer follows a short Coin composition and keeps the final decision at the bottom of the host.

avoidWhen.text: Confirmation or error feedback: keep it in the surrounding flow rather than inside the persistent footer.

from.quote: Keep confirmation or error feedback in the surrounding flow rather than inside the persistent footer.

anatomy.holds: The optional title: context above the actions, omitted when the decision is already clear.

from.quote: Optional context above the actions. Omit it when the decision is already clear.

anatomy.holds: A public ButtonGroup or Stack that owns the horizontal or vertical button layout.

from.quote: A public ButtonGroup or Stack owns horizontal or vertical button layout.

anatomy.holds: The token-owned surface: ActionFooter owns background, shadow, padding, radius and mode resolution.

from.quote: ActionFooter owns background, shadow, padding, radius, and mode resolution.

placementAdvice.text: On the web ActionFooter renders in normal flow; on native it pins the footer.

from.quote: Web renders in normal flow, native pins the footer

placementAdvice.text: The host supplies the width; the title and grouping change the footer's natural height.

from.quote: The host supplies width; title and grouping change the natural height.

placementAdvice.text: In a constrained host, the action composite changes its own height; ActionFooter stays full width.

from.quote: The composite changes its own height; ActionFooter remains full width.

placementAdvice.text: On web the footer renders in normal flow; on native it pins itself to the bottom. Keyboard avoidance remains the consumer's job.

from.quote: Web renders in normal flow, native pins the footer, and keyboard avoidance remains consumer-owned.

configuration.text: Use a ButtonGroup for a row of actions.

from.quote: Use a ButtonGroup for a row.

configuration.text: Use Stack when the actions need a vertical reading order.

from.quote: Use Stack when the actions need a vertical reading order.

configuration.text: For new code, pass a single ButtonGroup or Stack (or Slot) child: ActionFooter does not re-stretch it, only cascades modes and stretches it to full width. Loose Button and IconButton children are the legacy shape: an IconButton keeps its square size and the rest stretch.
Leave out the title when the preceding content already names the decision, to keep the surface short.

from.quote: Keep the surface short when the preceding content already names the decision.

configuration.text: Add a short title and stack the actions when horizontal space or hierarchy calls for it.

from.quote: Add a short title and stack actions when horizontal space or hierarchy calls for it.

configuration.text: Set modes on ActionFooter: they are merged into every slot child.
Configure disabled, loading or confirmation states on the footer's public child actions, and show feedback elsewhere: ActionFooter does not invent them.

from.quote: ActionFooter does not invent disabled, loading, or confirmation states. Configure those on its public child actions and show feedback elsewhere.

configuration.text: Do not make both actions primary: equal emphasis hides which action advances the decision.

from.quote: Equal emphasis hides which action advances the decision.

configuration.text: Where a keyboard can cover the footer, handle keyboard avoidance in the consuming implementation: avoidKeyboard is deprecated and has no effect.
Bottom spacing differs between Figma and the package: Figma's sample has 41px; the package defaults to 24px (bottomPadding) plus an optional safe-area inset (safeAreaBottom).

from.quote: Figma’s sample includes 41px bottom spacing; the package defaults to 24px plus an optional safe-area inset.
Give one action clear priority.

rules.text: Lead with the decision: use one clear primary action, such as Continue or Confirm payment.

from.quote: Use one clear primary action such as Continue or Confirm payment.
Use short verb-led labels.

rules.text: Keep labels short: Continue and Back scan faster than sentences that repeat the screen title.

from.quote: Continue and Back scan faster than sentences that repeat the screen title.

rules.text: Name the decision: labels such as Back and Confirm payment describe both outcomes directly.

from.quote: Back and Confirm payment describe both outcomes directly.

rules.text: Avoid vague action labels such as Yes and Go: they make people infer what will happen next.

from.quote: Yes and Go make people infer what will happen next.

rules.text: Keep the title concise: a short title adds context without repeating the action.

from.quote: A short title adds context without repeating the action.

rules.text: Do not repeat the instruction in the title: a long title slows scanning and duplicates the primary action.

from.quote: A long title slows scanning and duplicates the primary action.

rules.text: Show confirmation, validation or failure near the content that changed.

from.quote: Show confirmation, validation, or failure near the content that changed.

props.name: children
props.description: A single ButtonGroup, Stack or Slot child owns its internal layout and receives the footer's modes. Declared: Content to render inside the action footer slot. **Legacy (fully supported):** pass loose `IconButton` / `Button` children — IconButtons keep their intrinsic square size; everything else is auto-stretched to share the remaining horizontal space equally. **Figma shape (preferred for new code):** pass a single `ButtonGroup` (or `Stack` / `Slot`) that owns its own internal layout. ActionFooter will not re-stretch that composite — it only cascades `modes` and stretches it to full width.

props.name: title
props.description: Optional centered title rendered above the action slot (Figma "title wrap"). Omitted / empty string → title wrap is not mounted (identical to the pre-title layout tree for loose children).

props.name: modes
props.description: Mode configuration passed to the token resolver. Automatically merged into every slot child via {@link cloneChildrenWithModes} so callers don't have to thread modes down by hand.

props.name: style
props.description: Optional style overrides for the footer chrome (not the sticky shell).

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description: Accessibility label for the footer region (announced for the toolbar).

props.name: avoidKeyboard
props.description: Keyboard avoidance is consumer-owned: the footer does not avoid the keyboard. Declared: Deprecated: Keyboard avoidance is now owned by the consuming implementation. This prop is retained for backwards compatibility, defaults to `false`, and has no effect. Default false, from the component source.

props.name: safeAreaBottom
props.description: Optionally adds the native safe-area inset to the 24px bottom padding. Declared: Add the device's bottom safe-area inset to the footer padding so its actions clear system UI such as the home indicator. Default `true`.

props.name: bottomPadding
props.description: Defaults to 24; the native safe-area inset is optionally added. Declared: Fixed spacing added below the footer content, in addition to the optional safe-area inset. Default `24`.

modes.name: Action Footer Radius
modes.description: The Figma reference selects False. Declared: A token collection ActionFooter reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.
